|lore='As a token of my good will, I present to you a gift: these two droids. Both are hardworking and will serve you well.'
|game_text=If you just moved a droid to Audience Chamber, deploy on table. You may not cancel battles. Force loss from Or Be Destroyed may not be reduced and is limited to 3. While Han with your non-'hit' Chewie, Lando, or Luke, Han may not be targeted by weapons. [Immune to Control.]
|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[A Gift (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[A Gift (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 5 March 2023<ref name="ht-32e1135">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual21-Light/large/agift.gif</code> as published 5 March 2023: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/32e11351311a33497ffb43a1612b36c3ae669e88/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/agift.gif holotable commit 32e1135] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009023430id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/agift.gif publisher copy, identical file].</ref>: “If you just moved a droid to Audience Chamber, deploy on table. You may not cancel battles. Force loss from Or Be Destroyed may not be reduced and is limited to 3. While Han with your non-'hit' Chewie, Lando, or Luke, Han may not be targeted by weapons. [Immune to Control.]”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Gift (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 21]] (18 June 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>, page 5, file created 17 June 2023: “If you just moved a droid to Audience Chamber, deploy on table. You may not cancel battles. Force loss from Or Be Destroyed may not be reduced and is limited to 3. While Han with your non-'hit' Chewie, Lando, or Luke, Han may not be targeted by weapons. [Immune to Control.]” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[A Gift (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•A Gift”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[A Gift (V)]] (published 5 March 2023) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[A Gift]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). The PDF was created on 17 June 2023, the day before the set's release (18 June 2023); the sheet was published with the set, so the slip is placed after the card image in place at release. '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
